title: What is DIDS v2?
content: DIDS v2 is the next generation of the Data Integration Delivery Service supporting national collection ingestion, processing and delivery through the NDIT platform.
summary: Overview of the DIDS v2 programme.

title: DIDS Problem Statement
content: DIDS v2 exists to provide a scalable and governed approach for onboarding, processing and distributing nationally collected datasets within NDIT.

title: DIDS Architecture Overview
content: DIDS uses a staged data processing architecture supporting ingestion, validation, transformation and publication of datasets through NDIT services.

title: DIDS Onboarding Process
content: Onboarding a new DIDS dataset includes business approval, governance review, onboarding assessment, technical integration, testing and operational readiness.

title: DIDS Governance Requirements
content: Governance activities may include DSA, DPIA, Security Review, Design Authority review and onboarding assurance depending on the use case.

title: DIDS Risks
content: Key risks include platform readiness, governance approvals, onboarding lead times, data quality issues and service integration dependencies.

title: DIDS Incident Management
content: Operational incidents should be raised through the approved support route and escalated using the DIDS support model.

title: DIDS Roles and Responsibilities
content: Ownership is shared across product, engineering, governance and operational teams. Responsibilities vary depending on lifecycle stage and service usage.

title: DIDS Service Dependencies
content: DIDS integrations may depend on Foundry, CRDL, MESH, PET and supporting NDIT services.

title: DIDS Go Live Checklist
content: Go live activities include approvals, testing completion, governance sign-off, operational readiness review and support transition.
